Re-Take est un podcast indépendant qui p: Re-Take is an independent podcast that revisits topics with the benefit of hindsight. The format invites you to re-examine what you thought you knew, correct simplified narratives and deepen your understanding of complex events.
Une chaîne YouTube de parodie d'animes —: An anime parody YouTube channel — Re:Take takes frozen scenes and redubs them entirely to turn them into absurd sketches. A unique format at the crossroads of animation, dubbing and parody, with a strong identity and very knowing humour. The concept is brilliant but relies on a precise mechanism — the surprise can wear off over time. Our verdict: "An excellent example of creativity under constraint." — Alex. A channel that managed to create something unique on YouTube, now at a turning point after Maxime Hoareau's departure in 2024.
